statuses.label: Sourcing
statuses.hint: With TA — not sent to RMG / GM for screening yet.

statuses.label: On Hold
statuses.hint: TA parked the candidate (not reachable, over budget, waiting on documents …) — the reason is in the history. Release the hold to continue.

statuses.label: Technical Screening
statuses.hint: With RMG / GM — they screen the CV and shortlist or reject it on the Screening Desk.

statuses.label: RMG Rejected
statuses.hint: RMG / GM rejected the candidate at screening or review.

statuses.label: Technical Interview
statuses.hint: RMG / GM shortlisted the CV. Next: schedule the AI L1 or ask TA to book a manual L1.

statuses.label: AI L1 – Yet to Schedule
statuses.hint: AI L1 is wanted but not booked yet. TA agrees a time with the candidate.

statuses.label: AI L1 – Scheduled
statuses.hint: AI L1 is booked. The AI interview records the verdict after the interview.

statuses.label: AI L1 – Passed
statuses.hint: AI L1 passed. The next round or hand-off is due.

statuses.label: AI L1 – Failed
statuses.hint: AI L1 did not go well.

statuses.label: AI L1 – Under Review
statuses.hint: The AI interview is done; a recruiter put the result on hold / review.

statuses.label: Manual L1 – Yet to Schedule
statuses.hint: Manual L1 is wanted but not booked yet. TA agrees a time with the candidate.

statuses.label: Manual L1 – Scheduled
statuses.hint: Manual L1 is booked. RMG records the verdict after the interview.

statuses.label: Manual L1 – Passed
statuses.hint: Manual L1 passed. The next round or hand-off is due.

statuses.label: Manual L1 – Failed
statuses.hint: Manual L1 did not go well.

statuses.label: Manual L2 – Yet to Schedule
statuses.hint: Manual L2 is wanted but not booked yet. TA agrees a time with the candidate.

statuses.label: Manual L2 – Scheduled
statuses.hint: Manual L2 is booked. RMG records the verdict after the interview.

statuses.label: Manual L2 – Passed
statuses.hint: Manual L2 passed. The next round or hand-off is due.

statuses.label: Manual L2 – Failed
statuses.hint: Manual L2 did not go well.

statuses.label: With Sales – Ready to Submit
statuses.hint: Internal rounds cleared. Sales reviews and submits the profile to the customer.

statuses.label: Submitted to Customer
statuses.hint: The profile is with the customer. Sales records whether they shortlist it.

statuses.label: Customer Interviewing
statuses.hint: The customer is interviewing the candidate. Sales records Pass / Fail.

statuses.label: Customer L1 – Profile Shortlisted
statuses.hint: The customer shortlisted the profile; the L1 interview is not booked yet.

statuses.label: Customer L1 – Scheduled
statuses.hint: Customer L1 is booked. Sales records the verdict after the interview.

statuses.label: Customer L1 – Passed
statuses.hint: Customer L1 passed. The next round or hand-off is due.

statuses.label: Customer L1 – Failed
statuses.hint: Customer L1 did not go well.

statuses.label: Customer L2 – Yet to Schedule
statuses.hint: Customer L2 is wanted but not booked yet. TA agrees a time with the candidate.

statuses.label: Customer L2 – Scheduled
statuses.hint: Customer L2 is booked. Sales records the verdict after the interview.

statuses.label: Customer L2 – Passed
statuses.hint: Customer L2 passed. The next round or hand-off is due.

statuses.label: Customer L2 – Failed
statuses.hint: Customer L2 did not go well.

statuses.label: Customer Shortlisted
statuses.hint: The customer selected the candidate. Sales submits the rate and onboarding date.

statuses.label: Terms Sent Back
statuses.hint: Sales Head sent the rate / onboarding date back — Sales revises and resubmits.

statuses.label: Pending Sales Head Approval
statuses.hint: Sales submitted the terms. Only the Sales Head approves, sends back or rejects.

statuses.label: HR Discussion
statuses.hint: Terms approved. HR reviews the candidate's details and requests the HR round.

statuses.label: HR Round
statuses.hint: The HR round is booked. HR records the verdict, which moves the candidate on.

statuses.label: Pre-Onboarding
statuses.hint: Offer stage. HR completes the joining formalities and marks Joined.

statuses.label: Pre-Onboarding – Budget Concern
statuses.hint: HR's verdict was Not Recommend — HR checks the CTC / joining date and flags it to Sales if it does not fit.

statuses.label: Out of Budget – With Sales
statuses.hint: HR flagged the terms out of budget — Sales talks to the customer and replies to HR.

statuses.label: Budget Reply – With HR
statuses.hint: Sales replied to HR's budget flag — HR decides whether to complete onboarding.

statuses.label: Joined
statuses.hint: The candidate has joined.

statuses.label: Sales Rejected
statuses.hint: Sales decided not to submit the candidate to the customer.

statuses.label: Customer Rejected
statuses.hint: The customer rejected the candidate.

statuses.label: Self Withdrawn
statuses.hint: The candidate withdrew.

statuses.label: Rejected
statuses.hint: Closed as rejected.

statuses.label: Rejected by TA
statuses.hint: TA closed the candidate before screening — the reason is in the history.
